Dear students,
Everyone is requested to be present at NLH for tomorrow's class and we will have the distribution of the Quiz 2 paper, as informed by Ballav Sir.

posts.text: Dear All, Quiz 3 will be conducted on Tuesday 17-Nov-2026 during TA session 12-1 pm. The syllabus will be Crystal Field Theory and related (not molecular orbital theory, MOT and Pi-Bonding). Lecture Notes: Please refer to the text books Shriver Atkins BOOK 5th Edition Page 473 to 483 and Huheey, Keiter and Keiter BOOK International Online 4th Edition Page 394 to 413 (or Huheey, Keiter and Keiter BOOK in Our Library Pearson 4th Edition Hard Copy Binding Page 424 to 444). Best wishes, NB
